1. **23.8% top capture vs 0% for 7 of your top-25 reps** — Your highest digital adopter processes nearly a quarter of their total business through the platform, while 7 reps representing $18.6M in combined all-channel revenue have 0% platform attribution. The workflow gap, not territory difference, is the fastest growth lever. [→ §sales]

2. **$194K combined coaching upside from 4 priority reps** — Behavioral analysis identified 4 reps with clear funnel gaps: product discovery deficits, presentation avoidance, and below-median AOVs. Closing these gaps through targeted coaching could add an estimated $194K in annual platform GMV with zero new customer acquisition. [HYPOTHETICAL] [→ §sales]

3. **26.8% vs 0.5% conversion spread** — Your most efficient closer converts one in four customer-facing presentations to orders; your least efficient converts one in 200. The 23-point spread across your presenting reps suggests high-volume presenters need better targeting, not more activity. [→ §sales]

4. **Top new-item champion adopted 47% of 369 launches** — One rep introduced 175 of your 369 new products to customers, generating $257K in new-item revenue. But only 2 of your top 20 reps exceed 30% adoption, leaving substantial new-item revenue unrealized across the team. [→ §sales]
